proposal.name: Show when Codex thinking is still pending

plan.name: Show when Codex thinking is still pending
plan.summary: Add thinkingPending to the live JSON so a running Codex card with no completed reasoning item and no turn.completed shows Pending with the explanation reported when the run ends, without a numeric thinking count or numeric thinking legend. A completed reasoning item clears pending and shows the existing estimate, even when that estimate is zero; turn.completed clears pending and uses reasoning_output_tokens when present, including exact zero, preserving the existing replacement, summation and formatting rules. Keep this distinction per transcript across polls, rereads and trimmed timeline marks, reset it on transcript replacement, clear it when the agent or step ends, and preserve Claude Code's streamed counts and the public view's privacy. Update the Codex live-view descriptions in SPEC.md and README.md, retaining the relevant D-0051, D-0116, D-0136 and D-0164 citations on the SPEC bullet as D-0122 requires. Whoever merges records the pending-report wording as a decision refining D-0164 and adds its SPEC citation, since this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestCodexThinkingIsPendingWhileStepsContinue
tests.says: The live JSON marks Codex thinking pending while tools run without reasoning or completion, whether Codex is named by the watcher or detected from its transcript, and stops promising a later report when the agent or step ends.

tests.name: TestCodexPendingThinkingBecomesReportedUsage
tests.says: Pending survives a partial completion event, then clears for the whole event and publishes the reported exact count, including zero, retaining the completed-turn sum across polls, later turns, rereads and the step's end; a legacy completion without reasoning usage clears pending without claiming exactness.

tests.name: TestCodexPendingThinkingBecomesAnEstimate
tests.says: A whole reasoning item replaces pending with its existing estimate, including a zero estimate, until exact usage arrives; trimming the old reasoning mark or starting another session never makes the count pending again.

tests.name: TestThinkingPendingBelongsToItsCodexTranscript
tests.says: Concurrent Codex cards keep separate pending states, replacing a transcript restores pending for that run alone, and Claude Code continues publishing its streamed thinking estimates without pending.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and four acceptance tests for pending Codex thinking, preserving estimates, exact totals, and Claude Code behavior. The check passed: all four tests fail on the baseline as required, and `repo/` is unchanged.
